assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: full-bleed background plate for the living city scene in netKonnect; wide panoramic watercolor landscape, 3:1 ratio.
Primary request: paint a lush continuous countryside that will hold a growing city on the RIGHT and evolving animated roads flowing from an application on the LEFT. This image is the terrain underneath separately drawn roads/buildings/vehicles, so leave the middle and right meadow clear of buildings and roads, but fully painted with grass, never white empty space.
Input images: reference-poster.png is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; match its delicate navy ink outlines, transparent-looking watercolor washes, sage greenery, pale blue and warm cream natural palette. Do not reproduce its text or layout.
Scene/backdrop: top 35 percent pale blue washed sky with distant hazy hills; bottom 65 percent continuous gently rolling sage and olive green grassy meadow. Small clumps of wildflowers, grasses, bushes, tiny rabbits and a grazing deer at the extreme lower edges. Loose trees grouped near the far edges, leaving a broad uninterrupted grassy horizontal corridor throughout the central half for roads and city placement. A thin meandering pale blue stream along the very bottom edge, confined to the bottom 10 percent; the code will add a larger navigable river when ports unlock.
Style/medium: hand painted watercolor on subtle cold press paper with light navy ink detail, cozy illustrated storybook world, crisp enough for a UI banner, NO photorealism or 3D. Very airy yet full bleed colored landscape, not faded to white.
Composition/framing: wide panorama, gentle elevated side view matching the reference building elevations, no roads, no buildings, no vehicles, no text, no logos, no frames. Low horizon. Every pixel has a light sky or grassy wash. Natural terrain continues cleanly to all four edges.
Lighting/mood: neutral soft daylight, slightly warm and optimistic; the application will tint this at dawn, dusk and night.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent watercolor environment sprite sheet for netKonnect's living city landscape.
Input images: reference-poster.png is the style reference. Match its light navy ink outlines, sage green foliage, terracotta accents, pale blue watercolor, warm ivory and textured paper brushwork.
Primary request: six distinct decorative assets in a precise three-column by two-row grid on a genuinely transparent background. Each object stays entirely inside its equally sized cell with generous transparent gutters; nothing crosses cells. No panel borders or labels.
Top left: two puffy pale blue and ivory watercolor clouds, compact horizontal arrangement.
Top middle: a small flock of five blue-grey birds in flight, simple delicate watercolor silhouettes and visible wings, horizontal arrangement.
Top right: a cluster of three lush green leafy trees, small wildflowers below, navy ink outlines, elevated side view.
Bottom left: a pair of slender navy boulevard streetlamps with warm glowing golden lights and a small terracotta flower planter at their bases.
Bottom middle: a small river freight dock in elevated side view, timber pier, modest blue-roofed harbor shed, ochre dock crane and stacked colorful crates. No water and no ships; transparent surrounding space so it can sit above a code-drawn river.
Bottom right: a tiny city park with two green trees, a wooden bench, flowering shrubs and a curved pale gravel footpath.
Style/medium: true watercolor and thin hand drawn navy linework, charming storybook miniature, the same world as the reference. Legible at very small sizes.
Constraints: exactly 6 isolated items, equal grid cells, generous transparent padding, no background landscape, no buildings except the dock shed, no text, no watermark. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside objects.
